items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I knew him quite well. I never worked with Jack much, in fact I never worked at all with him at all.

ctx.x: And what about Jack Purvis, did you know him?

Like I told you, I knew Jack, he was always around the street then. I never worked with Jack much, in fact I never worked at all with him at all. I can recall, but I knew him quite well. I don't think I looked good at anything with Jack.
